findings.location: source.html paragraph: "Wander near the nest of a swallow..." (third full paragraph)
findings.source_quote: Wander near the nest of a swallow and you will find that they have ways of expressing depreciation as well.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the clause to preserve the original meaning about the nest. For example: "Vandra nära en svalas bo så finner du att de också har sätt att uttrycka förakt." (Keep HTML tags and surrounding paragraph text intact.)
findings.translation_quote: Vandra nära en svalaunge och du finner att de också har sätt att uttrycka förakt.

findings.location: source.html paragraph: bird-species list (paragraph beginning "It is the nature of the birds to sing.")
findings.source_quote: The song of the wren trumps them all for longevity and vibrancy.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the bird species name to match the source ("wren") rather than translating to a different species. For example: replace the incorrect Swedish bird name with a correct Swedish equivalent for 'wren' (gärdsmyg) so the sentence reads: "Gärdsmygens sång slår dem alla vad gäller livslängd och livskraft." (Preserve surrounding tags and punctuation.)
findings.translation_quote: Kungsfågelns sång slår dem alla vad gäller livslängd och livskraft.

findings.location: source.html paragraph: paragraph about "Neglect" (mentions cowbird and Philistines/Gen 26:15)
findings.source_quote: The cowbird is also black (the female is brown/gray). ... The Philistines “had filled them with earth” (Gen 26:15).
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the correct bird name and the correct people name. 'Cowbird' should not be translated as 'cuckoo' — use an appropriate Swedish rendering (e.g., 'cowbird' can be left as 'cowbird' or described as 'cowbird (Molothrus)'; alternatively use a descriptive phrase). Also correct 'Filerna' to 'Filistéerna' (Philistines) in the Genesis citation. For example: replace "Cuckoofågeln" with "cowbird (cowbird)" or a Swedish descriptive term, and replace "Filerna "had filled them with earth"" with "Filistéerna 'had filled them with earth' (Gen 26:15)."
findings.translation_quote: Cuckoofågeln är också svart (honan är brun/grå). ... Filerna “had filled them with earth” (Gen 26:15).

findings.location: source.html paragraph: list of "foul fowl" (paragraph beginning "Sin.")
findings.source_quote: Of such are the worthless blackbirds, starlings, and grackles. The crows show themselves also at the roadside...
findings.suggested_fix: Adjust the Swedish rendering to preserve the original species and sense. The translation currently repeats 'star'/'staren' redundantly and renders species inconsistently. Use appropriate Swedish names for the English list (e.g., 'svartfåglar (blackbirds), starar (starlings) och gracklar (grackles)') or keep the English common names in italics/quotes if necessary. Ensure 'crow' is rendered as 'kråkor' as in the source. Example replacement: "Av sådana är de värdelösa svartfåglarna, stararna och gracklarna. Kråkor visar sig också vid vägkanten..."
findings.translation_quote: Av sådana är de värdelösa stararna, staren och gracklarna. Kråkor visar sig också vid vägkanten, födosökande på ruttnande kadaver.
